visualCharacteristics.purpose: inline image preview with a zoom icon that opens all slides in a modal carousel
traits: first slide shown inline (half width from 600px) with a round zoom icon
dark modal dialog with close button, prev/next arrows and bullets
Escape, backdrop click or close button closes; focus returns to the preview
arrow keys navigate; a single slide shows no arrows or bullets

contentPattern.structure: One row per slide. Cell 1: image (required, with alt text; rows without an image are not slides). Cell 2 (optional): caption shown under the image in the lightbox. The first slide's image is the inline preview button. Optional label rows (2 cells, no image) for UI strings, with defaults by page language: Open label (EN 'Enlarge image', DE 'Bild vergrößern'), Close label ('Close' / 'Schließen'), Previous label ('Previous image' / 'Vorheriges Bild'), Next label ('Next image' / 'Nächstes Bild'), Dialog label ('Image gallery' / 'Bildergalerie'), Slide label ('{n} of {total}' / '{n} von {total}'). Other rows without an image are ignored; a block without any image is hidden

reuseGuidance: Use when one image preview should open a set of large images in a modal. For several teasers visible inline use carousel-cards.
